titel: Kitzbühel Events 2026 – From the Hahnenkamm Downhill to the Jazz Festival
teaser: Kitzbühel is so much more than the legendary Hahnenkamm downhill: All year round, world-class events draw visitors—from sports to culture.
inhalt:
**[Kitzbühel](/orte/kitzbuehel/)** has built a reputation as a premier event destination in the Alps. Whether it’s the legendary **Hahnenkamm-Rennen** in January, open-air concerts in summer, or the traditional Advent season—there’s always something happening here.

## **Hahnenkamm-Rennen (January)**

The absolute highlight of winter: the **Hahnenkamm-Abfahrt** on the **Streif** is considered the world’s most demanding ski race. The event weekend attracts over 80,000 visitors annually.

**Date 2026:** 23.–25. January
**Highlights:** Downhill (Sat), Slalom (Sun), city-wide events

## **Kitzbüheler Sommerkonzerte (July–August)**

Classical music under the open sky at the **Kitzbüheler Bergbühne** on **Kitzbüheler Horn**. International orchestras and soloists perform works from Mozart to Strauss.

**Tip:** Bring a picnic blanket and enjoy the view of the **Kitzbüheler Alpen**.

## **Kitzbühel Jazz Festival (September)**

A weekend dedicated entirely to jazz. International stars perform in the town center, hotels, and at the **Hahnenkamm** mountain station.

## **Advent in Kitzbühel (November–December)**

One of Tirol’s most beautiful **Christkindlmärkte**. Over 50 stalls offer handcrafted art and culinary specialties around **Liebfrauenkirche**, along with daily music performances and a children’s carousel.

## **Service**
- Book all events early at [www.kitzbuehel.com](http://www.kitzbuehel.com)
- **Kitzbüheler Gästekarte**: free entry to many events
- Parking in Advent is extremely limited—public transport recommended
